papers.title: HPP: Hierarchical Programmatic Probing for Long Video Understanding by Decoupling Perception and Reasoning
papers.authors: Awais Rauf, Ahmed Hasssan, Greg Slabaugh
papers.tags: multimodal learning, video segmentation, video search, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: Queen's University Belfast; AMD; Queen Mary University of London
papers.intro: 本文提出HPP框架，通过将长视频理解重构为对分层分割视频的迭代程序化探测，将语义感知与高阶时序推理解耦，使具备编码能力的LLM在交互式编码环境中规划并执行多步策略，按需调用轻量级VLM进行局部感知，从而显著提升长视频理解性能。

papers.title: T-MOR: Learning Motion-Aware Skeleton Representations for Human Action Recognition
papers.authors: Di Yang, Mahmoud Ali, Quan Kong, Gianpiero Francesca, Francois Bremond
papers.affiliations: Suzhou Institute for Advanced Research, University of Science and Technology of China; Inria Center at Université Côte d’Azur; Woven by Toyota; Toyota Motor Europe
papers.intro: T-MOR提出一种通过聚类引导的多模态对比学习，将骨架运动表示与视频和文本语义对齐的框架，训练后仅用轻量骨架输入即可进行动作识别，并实现强大的零样本与少样本迁移能力。

papers.title: Real-time pedestrian attribute recognition with YOLOv8 and ResNet18
papers.authors: Houssam El Mir
papers.affiliations: College of Computer Science and Technology, Zhejiang University of Technology, Hangzhou, 310023, Zhejiang, China
papers.intro: 本文提出并验证了一个由YOLOv8n负责行人检测、三个基于ResNet18的任务头分别负责性别分类、表现年龄回归和61属性多标签分类的轻量级两阶段实时行人属性识别流水线，并通过PETA与PA-100K数据集的语义标签映射实现大规模统一训练。

papers.title: TimeProVe: Propose, then Verify for Efficient Long Video Temporal Reasoning in Activities of Daily Living
papers.authors: Arkaprava Sinha, Dominick Reilly, Siddharth Krishnan, Hieu Le, Srijan Das
papers.tags: video segmentation, multimodal learning, video generation, diffusion model, video search
papers.affiliations: University of North Carolina, Charlotte
papers.intro: TimeProVe提出了一种成本高效的混合框架，先用轻量级模块生成基于动作的答案-证据假设，再仅对选定的短视频片段调用昂贵的VLM进行定向验证，从而在保持高准确率的同时大幅降低长视频问答的计算成本。

papers.title: Reliability-Aware Prototype Calibration for Frozen Pose-Flow Video Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Ning Dong, Yingna Su, Xin Dong, Ziyun Jiao, Xinnian Guo, Zhuangzhuang Pan
papers.affiliations: Suqian University; Nanjing University of Information Science and Technology; University of Electronic Science and Technology of China; Universiti Malaya
papers.intro: RPC是一种针对冻结姿态流视频异常检测器的后置评分校准方法，通过在冻结潜在空间中计算最近原型偏差并将其与标准化似然分数相结合，同时用关键点置信度门控该几何证据，从而在不改变骨干网络的情况下提升帧级异常排序性能。

papers.title: Vortex: Multi-Modal Fusion System for Intelligent Video Retrieval
papers.authors: Duc-Tho Nguyen, Hieu-Hoc Tran-Minh, Khanh-Hoa Lam, Hoang-Nhut Ly, Huu-Phuc Huynh, Thanh-Tien Tran, Trung-Nghia Le
papers.affiliations: University of Science, VNU-HCM, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam; Vietnam National University, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
papers.intro: Vortex 是面向 AIC'25 设计的多模态视频检索系统，通过 AutoShot 关键帧提取、Qwen2.5-VL 和 Whisper 多模态元数据生成、CLIP 与 SigLIP2 双嵌入经 Reciprocal Rank Fusion 融合，并引入 Rocchio 相关反馈与多阶段时序重排，…

papers.title: DREAM: Extending Vision-Language Models with Dual-Objective Encoding for Cross-Modal Retrieval
papers.authors: Kaleem Ullah, Altaf Hussain, Muhammad Munsif, Sung Wook Baik
papers.affiliations: Sejong University, Seoul 143-747, South Korea; KAIST InnoCORE PRISM-AI Center, Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), Daejeon, 34141, Republic of Korea; Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology (UNIST), Ulsan, 44919, Republic of Korea
papers.intro: 论文提出DREAM框架，通过结合掩码与置换语言建模的双目标文本编码器和带有级联组注意力的分层视觉编码器，实现视频与文本间更精细、更全局的跨模态语义对齐，在三个标准基准上取得了新的最优性能。

papers.title: MyPCBench: A Benchmark for Personally Intelligent Computer-Use Agents
papers.authors: Lawrence Keunho Jang, Andrew Keunwoo Jang, Jing Yu Koh, Ruslan Salakhutdinov
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University
papers.intro: MyPCBench提出了一个可复现的Linux桌面基准测试，通过为单个标准角色（Michael Scott from The Office）播种17个模拟真实Web应用和完整桌面堆栈的跨应用一致数据，定义了184个基于真实用户请求的任务，并评测了6个封闭/开放权重模型，揭示最佳模型（Claude O…

papers.title: Multimodal LLM-Empowered Re-Ranking for Generalizable Person Re-Identification
papers.authors: Jiachen Li, Xiaojin Gong
papers.tags: multimodal learning, image retrieval, CLIP, video search
papers.affiliations: College of Information Science and Electronic Engineering, Zhejiang University
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的重排序增强方法（MUSE），通过域无关提示和难样本挖掘对MLLM进行监督微调，再将其预测距离与欧氏距离融合为μ-distance，从而显著提升域泛化行人重识别中重排序的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Conditional Multi-Event Temporal Grounding in Long-Form Video
papers.authors: Yuanhao Zou, Arthad Kulkarni, Lucas Tonanez, Lincoln Spencer, Guangyu Sun, Tianxingjian Ding, Andong Deng, Yi Li, Shuangjun Liu, Yuan Li, Dashan Gao, Ning Bi, Taotao Jing, Shuai Zhang, Chen Chen
papers.tags: video search, video segmentation, tracking, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: University of Central Florida（作者1-8、作者15）；Qualcomm AI Research（作者9-14）
papers.intro: 本文提出CoMET-Bench——首个面向长视频的条件多事件时间定位基准（含2,789个查询、600个视频），并配套统一评估协议和Rejection-F1指标，同时提出训练免费的CoMET-Agent智能体框架，通过结构化搜索-聚合将F1@0.5提升6.1%。

papers.title: OSGuard: A Benchmark for Safety in Computer-Use Agents
papers.authors: Mina Mohammadmirzaei, Jeffrey Flanigan
papers.affiliations: University of California, Santa Cruz
papers.intro: 提出OSGuard，一种双粒度安全基准套件，用于在良性、不变的用户指令下评估计算机使用代理的安全性，包含动作级局部护栏决策基准与风险增强执行套件，并通过不变式将安全完成与不安全完成区分开。

papers.title: Gaze Heads: How VLMs Look at What They Describe
papers.authors: Rohit Gandikota, David Bau
papers.affiliations: Northeastern University
papers.intro: 论文发现并定义了一组称为“gaze heads”的注意力头，其注意力动态跟踪模型当前描述的图像区域，通过干预这些头的注意力可以高精度地指定模型描述的目标区域。

papers.title: OmniVideo-100K: A Dataset for Audio-Visual Reasoning through Structured Scripts and Evidence Chains
papers.authors: Xinyue Cai, Chaoyou Fu, Yi-Fan Zhang, Ran He, Caifeng Shan
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, scene understanding, video search
papers.affiliations: Nanjing University, CASIA
papers.intro: 本文提出一种自动音频-视觉问答数据引擎，通过“实体锚定视频脚本”和“线索引导QA生成”两个机制构建了OmniVideo-100K数据集，在多个模型上取得了显著的性能提升，并展现了良好泛化能力。

papers.title: RepFusion: Leveraging Multimodal Priors for Denoising in Representation Space
papers.authors: Xichen Pan, Aashu Singh, Satya Narayan Shukla, Xiangjun Fan, Shlok Kumar Mishra, Saining Xie
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Meta AI, New York University
papers.intro: RepFusion提出将冻结的预训练多模态大语言模型（MLLM）重新用作噪声表示编码器，通过将带噪的RAE潜在表示馈入MLLM，将其输出的动态条件信号用于扩散Transformer去噪，从而在相似推理FLOPs下显著优于传统方法。

papers.title: Instruct-Particulate: Scaling Feed-Forward 3D Object Articulation with Kinematic Control
papers.authors: Ruining Li, Yuxin Yao, Matt Zhou, Chuanxia Zheng, Christian Rupprecht, Joan Lasenby, Shangzhe Wu, Andrea Vedaldi
papers.affiliations: University of Oxford, University of Cambridge, Nanyang Technological University
papers.intro: 提出Instruct-Particulate模型，通过显式运动学指令（部分描述、连接关系、关节类型、可选点提示）从静态3D网格中前馈预测关节部分分割和运动参数，并构建15万+异构数据集实现跨类别泛化。

papers.title: Memento: Reconstruct to Remember for Consistent Long Video Generation
papers.authors: Xuan Wei, Longbin Ji, Guan Wang, Xiangrui Liu, Zhenyu Zhang, Shuohuan Wang, Yu Sun, Qingqi Hong
papers.affiliations: Xiamen University, ERNIE Team, Baidu Inc
papers.intro: 本文提出 Memento 框架，通过基于记忆的主体重建辅助目标和双查询记忆机制，将长视频生成中的主体一致性显式地作为身份基础问题来解决，实现跨镜头主体身份保持与视觉连贯性。

papers.title: Giving AI a Headache: Acoustic Adversarial Attacks to Computer Vision Applications
papers.authors: Nicole Villavicencio-Garduño, Maksim Ekin Eren, Milo Prisbrey, Ben Migliori, Michael Teti
papers.affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University, Los Alamos National Laboratory
papers.intro: 本文首次系统探索低频（0–200Hz）可听声波对相机传感器的攻击效果，通过物理实验证明声学共振可导致YOLOv11目标检测率下降近10%，并识别出20–30Hz和155–180Hz两个脆弱频段，揭示了三种检测误差模式。

papers.title: HPSv3++: Scaling Reward Models Across the Full Spectrum of Diffusion Model Capabilities
papers.authors: Yijun Liu, Jie Huang, Zeyue Xue, Yuming Li, Ruizhe He, Haoran Li, Shijia Ge, Siming Fu
papers.affiliations: Yijun Liu - Tsinghua University; Jie Huang - JD Explore Academy; Zeyue Xue - JD Explore Academy; Yuming Li - Peking University; Ruizhe He - Zhejiang University; Haoran Li - JD Explore Academy; Shijia Ge - Tsinghua University; Siming Fu - JD Explore Academy
papers.intro: 本文提出HPSv3++，一个通过两阶段训练（持续学习+半监督自适应训练）将奖励模型从静态单分数扩展为条件化（基于模型能力和RL迭代）的框架，在构建的212K双维度偏好数据集HPDv3++上实现9.8%的偏好预测提升，并能持续改善不同T2I模型的GenEval分数。

papers.title: NEST3D: A High-Resolution Multimodal Dataset of Sociable Weaver Tree Nests
papers.authors: Constanza A. Molina Catricheo, Simon Boeder, Ting-Jia Guo, Giacomo May, Clément Berthelot, Devis Tuia, Friedrich Fedor Reinhard, Fabio Remondino, Benjamin Risse
papers.affiliations: University of Münster; École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL); Max Planck Institute of Animal Behavior; University of Konstanz; Kuzikus Research Station; Fondazione Bruno Kessler (FBK)
papers.intro: 本文提出了NEST3D，一个1.4TB的多模态无人机数据集，包含104棵巢树的RGB/多光谱图像、3D点云和专家语义标注，并基准测试了三种3D分割模型，为生态遥感中的极端类别不平衡问题提供了新基准。

papers.title: A Lightweight Fiducial-Based Pipeline for 3D Hyperspectral Mapping of ex-vivo Lumpectomy Specimens
papers.authors: Anna Bicchi, Alberto Rota, Leonardo Passoni, Nicola Ancellotti, Andrea Peroni, Lorenzo Vinco, Dario Polli, Elena De Momi
papers.affiliations: Politecnico di Milano
papers.intro: 提出一种全自动、免标定的流水线，利用消费者相机RGB图像和单次俯视HSI采集，通过ArUco标记辅助的深度学习方法重建三维几何并注册HSI数据，生成三维高光谱点云，在离体标本上实现亚毫米级注册误差。
